findings.title: CVE-2026-0310 PAN-OS: Buffer Overflow Vulnerability via XML Processing
findings.summary_md: Palo Alto Networks published its advisory on 9 September 2026, describing a buffer overflow in PAN-OS XML processing (CVE-2026-0310, CWE-787) that allows unauthenticated network attackers to reach management or dataplane interfaces. The vendor states PA-Series hardware firewalls are vulnerable to root-level arbitrary code execution, while VM-Series is limited to a denial-of-service condition.

findings.title: A Malformed XML Request Can Give an Attacker Root on Palo Alto Hardware Firewalls
findings.summary_md: The analysis from 11 September 2026 details the root RCE impact on PA-Series hardware and notes the vulnerability was disclosed by Palo Alto on 9 September 2026 with the company stating no malicious exploitation was known at that time. It emphasizes no special configuration is required for exposure but that management interface reachability drives real-world risk.

findings.title: CVE-2026-111497 Portfolio Status: Impact of Brotli Vulnerability on Palo Alto Networks Products
findings.summary_md: Palo Alto confirmed on 26 October 2026 that CVE-2026-111497, a CVSS 9.2 Brotli decoder buffer overflow, affects PAN-OS 12.2, 12.1 and 11.2. The advisory notes affected Brotli library versions (1.0.3 through 1.2.0) must be updated to 1.0.10, 1.1.1 or 1.2.1, and the company was actively investigating product impact at the time of publication.
